description: This Java class, PersistableProductReviewPopulator, converts a PersistableProductReview object into a ProductReview object, fetching related entities like Customer, Product, and Language, and setting up their relations and data accordingly. It is part of the web presentation layer collaborating with service classes for data access within a shopping or e-commerce system.

classes.name: PersistableProductReviewPopulator
classes.description: A class that converts persistable review data into a domain model review object, linking it with customer, product, and language entities, and ensuring the data's validity and consistency.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a PersistableProductReview into a ProductReview object, setting review date, customer, product, and description details. Performs validation checks and retrieves related entities via services.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Method intended to create a new ProductReview instance, but currently returns null.
